counterfactual_missing_items: No cherry-red spot, hemorrhage, or peripheral neovascularization was present
Normal cilioretinal, retinal arteriolar, and retinal venous filling
No dehydration or other precipitating factors were noted
decisive_items: abnormal retinal capillary bed across the macula, with increased intercapillary spacing and small areas of hypofluorescence nasal to the fovea
response.rationale: R1 is strongly supported by HbSS sickle cell disease, black sunburst lesions, ischemic macular whitening, and capillary nonperfusion/hypofluorescence, all fitting sickle cell retinopathy. R4 is contradicted by absent cherry-red spot and normal retinal arteriolar filling. R2 lacks diabetes history and the findings are explained by sickle cell disease. C1 is contradicted because the cited span explicitly denies peripheral neovascularization, so proliferative retinopathy is not supported.

rejected.why: Ischemic macular whitening is nonspecific; absent cherry-red spot and normal retinal arteriolar/venous filling argue against central retinal artery occlusion.
No diabetes history is provided, and the capillary bed changes are better explained by sickle cell maculopathy.
The only raw support span explicitly states no peripheral neovascularization, directly contradicting the proliferative subtype completion.
